title: Authentication
content_data:
With the authorization code you receive after authorization by the business (the TikTok account user), you can make a request to the endpoint /tt_user/oauth2/token/ to get an `access_token` for subsequent API requests and a `refresh_token` for access token renewal. To get the TikTok account permission scopes that are authorized by the business, you can pass the generated access token to [/tt_user/token_info/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1765927978092545). **Access token expiry** The `access_token` is valid for one day. If an access token expires, you need to make a request to the /tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/ endpoint to renew the access token. Remember to pass in the `refresh_token` for a token renewal request. **Refresh token expiry** The `refresh_token` is valid for one year. If the refresh token expires, the developer needs to request the user to re-authorize their application via the user authorization workflow. ## Obtain a short-term access token Use this endpoint to get a TikTok account access token. ### Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | client_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer app.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| | client_secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer app.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | grant_type {Required} | string | The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:
  • `authorization_code`: To generate the access token by authorization code.
| | auth_code {Required} | string | The authorization code (`auth_code`) generated by your TikTok account holder authorization URL.

The code is valid for 10 minutes and can only be used once.

To find out how to get the authorization code based on the type of API you use, see the "Authorization URL" row in [Comparing authorization for different APIs](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781891256601602#item-link-Comparing%20authorization%20for%20different%20APIs). | | redirect_uri {Required} | string | The redirect URL which the client will be directed to.

Its value must be the same as the TikTok account holder redirect URL set in the app. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/token/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_id":"{{client_id}}", "client_secret":"{{client_secret}}", "grant_type":"authorization_code", "auth_code":"{{auth_code}}", "redirect_uri":"{{redirect_uri}}" }' (/code) ``` ### Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|access_token | string | The short-term token for permission verification.

The token expires in one day. | #|token_type | string | The type of token.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope | string | The scope of permissions granted to the access token. | #|expires_in | number | The time remaining until the access token expires, measured in seconds. | #|refresh_token | string | The refresh token, which can be used to renew the access token.

The refresh token is valid for one year.

Note: Retain this field for `access_token` renewal. | #|refresh_token_expires_in | number | The time remaining until the refresh token expires, measured in seconds. | #|open_id | string | Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86400, "open_id": "{{open_id}}", "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 31536000, "scope": "message.list.manage,video.list,video.insights,user.insights,user.info.basic,comment.list,biz.brand.insights,biz.spark.auth,tcm.order.update,comment.list.manage,video.upload,video.publish,biz.ads.recommend,user.account.type,biz.creator.info,user.info.username,message.list.send,user.info.profile,user.info.stats,message.list.read,biz.creator.insights", "token_type": "Bearer" } } (/code) ``` ## Renew a short-term access token Use this endpoint to renew a short-term TikTok account access token by `refresh_token`. ### Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| | client_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer app.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| | client_secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer app.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | grant_type {Required} | string | The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:

  • `refresh_token`: To generate the access token by refresh token.
| | refresh_token {Required} | string | Refresh token to renew an existing access token.

You can obtain the refresh token in the response of /tt_user/oauth2/token/ endpoint when you generate an access token. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_id":"{{client_id}}", "client_secret":"{{client_secret}}", "grant_type":"refresh_token", "refresh_token":"{{refresh_token}}" }' (/code) ``` ### Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data|object|Returned data.| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| #|access_token | string | The new short-term token for permission verification.

The token expires in one day. | #|token_type | string | The type of token.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope | string | The scope of permissions granted to the access token. | #|expires_in | number | The time remaining until the access token expires, measured in seconds. | #|refresh_token | string | The refresh token, which can be used to renew the access token.

The refresh token is valid for one year.

Note: Retain this field for `access_token` renewal. | #|refresh_token_expires_in | number | The time remaining until the refresh token expires, measured in seconds. | #|open_id | string | Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account. | ``` #### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "access_token": "{{access_token}}", "expires_in": 86400, "open_id": "{{open_id}}", "refresh_token": "{{refresh_token}}", "refresh_token_expires_in": 28484364, "scope": "message.list.manage,video.list,video.insights,user.insights,user.info.basic,comment.list,biz.brand.insights,biz.spark.auth,tcm.order.update,comment.list.manage,video.upload,video.publish,biz.ads.recommend,user.account.type,biz.creator.info,user.info.username,message.list.send,user.info.profile,user.info.stats,message.list.read,biz.creator.insights", "token_type": "Bearer" } } (/code) ```
